meta.title: 不生孩子也能传承：领养与善意
meta.title_en: Legacy Without Birth: Adoption and Warmth

scenes.title_en: Not having kids isn't a big deal
scenes.context: 讲者表达不觉得不生孩子是大事，同时承认衰弱时需要面对无至亲陪伴的现实。
sentences: 我倒不觉得（不生孩子）是一件大事情。
Personally, I don't think not having children is a big deal.
一件大事情：a big deal
如果你一旦做出了选择，不结婚不生子，当你比较衰弱的时候，身边没有至亲的人陪伴。
But once you've made the choice — no marriage, no kids — you face being alone when you're frail.
衰弱的时候：when you're frail
我们还是要有孩子比较好（的考量）。
Still, having kids is something worth weighing.
有孩子比较好：having kids has its merits
paraphrase: 轻松看待选择→但不回避代价
Treat it lightly, but don't hide from the real cost.
无至亲陪伴→是需要面对的现实
Facing frailty without family is the reality to accept.
scenes.speak: Personally, I don't think not having children is a big deal. But once you've made the choice — no marriage, no kids — you face being alone when you're frail. Still, having kids is something worth weighing.

scenes.context: 讲者回答如果再选一次，身体好的话会去领养几个孩子。
sentences: 假如咱们年轻的时候有再一次选择的机会，你会选择做母亲这个身份吗？
If you had the chance to choose again when you were young, would you take on the role of a mother?
做母亲：take on the role of a mother
我有可能，身体好的话，去领养几个孩子。
I might — if my health allowed — adopt a couple of children.
领养：adopt
我并不觉得在这个世界上一定要基因传承。
I don't believe the world requires genetic lineage.
基因传承：genetic lineage
paraphrase: 母亲=养育而非生育→领养成立
Motherhood is about raising, not birthing — adoption counts.
Passing on genes isn't a must.
scenes.speak: If you had the chance to choose again when you were young, would you take on the role of a mother? I might — if my health allowed — adopt a couple of children. I don't believe the world requires genetic lineage.

scenes.title_en: What carries on is warmth and kindness
scenes.context: 讲者说明自己的基因不比别人好，用善意和温暖来做传承更好。
sentences: 我的基因也并不比人家好到哪去。
My genes are nothing special compared to anyone else's.
好到哪去：nothing special
与其这样的话，用善意和温暖的感觉来做这个事情。
So instead, do it with kindness and warmth.
善意和温暖：kindness and warmth
那不是更好吗？
Wouldn't that be even better?
那不是更好吗：wouldn't that be better
paraphrase: 基因不比别人好→不执着于血脉
My genes aren't special, so I don't cling to bloodline.
善意与温暖→更值得的传承内容
Kindness and warmth make a more worthy legacy.
scenes.speak: My genes are nothing special compared to anyone else's. So instead, do it with kindness and warmth. Wouldn't that be even better?

practice: I don't think not having kids is a big deal.
If my health allowed, I'd adopt a couple of children.
I don't believe the world requires genetic lineage.
What I want to pass on is kindness and warmth.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I don't think this is a big matter.
✓ 地道说法：I don't think it's a big deal.
big deal 比 big matter 更口语。
✓ 地道说法：Adopt a couple of children.
a couple of 表达「几个」更自然。
✕ 直译腔：My genes are not better than others.
✓ 地道说法：My genes are nothing special compared to anyone else's.
nothing special 更口语地表达「不比别人好」。
✕ 直译腔：Use kindness and warmth to do this thing.
✓ 地道说法：Do it with kindness and warmth.
直接 do it with 更简洁自然。
shifts: 不生孩子不是件大事情
母亲=养育，领养也是母亲
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「还是生孩子比较好」按语境整理为「有孩子还是比较好的考量」；「自亲的人」校正为「至亲的人」；「基因传承」保留原意；「用善意和温暖的感觉来做这个事情」按语境整理。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
